nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Mineral Ultra-Light Face Sunscreen Fluid SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report a light, non-greasy, matte-finish feel and no breakouts, though one oily reviewer recommends it specifically for oily skin (i12) and another with very oily skin found it kept shine at bay (i75).
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed results: some describe it as drying and flaky with white, chalky patches (i8, i14, i17), while another with dry, pale skin calls the formula lovely and moisturizing (i44).
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally tolerate it well, citing no breakouts and a manageable slight white cast (i37, i45, i60).
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers largely report no irritation, redness, or breakouts, including those with rosacea, though one sensitive reviewer notes slight stinging over active breakouts (i35, i42, i53, i69).
segments.mature: One mature-skin reviewer with rosacea describes the formula as gentle and soothing with no white cast issue for her fair skin (i34).

concerns.aging: One reviewer values the antioxidant/photoaging protection angle and mentions using it for years without issue on mature skin (i34, i56).
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report dryness, flakiness, or chalky patches after use (i8, i14, i17, i23), though others with dry skin found it moisturizing rather than drying (i36, i44).
concerns.redness: Reviewers managing rosacea report calming, non-irritating wear with reduced flare-ups (i21, i69, i72), with no dissent noted.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers prone to irritation or rash-prone skin report no adverse reaction or breakouts from this product (i30, i42, i53).
concerns.spots: One reviewer using it for melasma and one for hyperpigmentation report it fits into their routine without worsening pigmentation, though white cast is noted as a cosmetic drawback over darker or pigmented skin (i31, i44).
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some describe visible improvement (i19, i37, i47, i55, i61, i76, i78); one dissenting reviewer reports breakouts and clogged pores after five days of use (i8), and another notes slight stinging over active blemishes (i35).
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report a matte, non-greasy finish that controls shine (i28, i40, i58, i75), with no notable dissent.

aspects.libelle: White cast on medium to dark skin
Sour or chemical smell after use

extraits.texte: I am hispanic and I am a light medium shade. I always use light beige or light tan foundation shades, and I'm serious when I tell you I am currently sitting in front of the mirror looking like casper the friendly ghost! The white cast on this SPF is INSANE. I irritated my skin from trying to rub it in so much. If you are very VERY light skinned- nearly white skin tone then I could see this working for you. Any pigment at all in your skin? DON'T DO IT. Returning immediately.

I recent change my Sun protractor from a Chemical to a Mineral sunscreen. I decided to try this one because I have read good reviews about it. I personally don't like it. It leaves a white residue on my face, absorbs to quick it doesn't blends equally leaving me with chalky marks all over my face. Makes my face really dry and clogged my pores making my skin looking old and with texture (wrinkles lines) I have only used it for 5 days and Is making my skin look bad causing breakouts. All my nose looks like a strawberry with hard white dots. Plus I think is a little pricey for the amount you getting. I was expecting a better formula for the price a payed.

extraits.titre: Good suncreen for acne prone skin
extraits.texte: I was hesitant to buy this sunscreen at first given the price and its size (I was used to buying the Cerave sunscreen) but after using this specific Anthelios sunscreen for months, this has become the new sunscreen in my skincare routine. I have acne prone oily skin and this sunscreen doesn't cause me to break out. It has a super light weight feeling on my skin which I love. The texture is more on the liquid side rather than cream side. My only criticism of the product is it's bad smell. It's not too bad but it is quite strong at first, but after a minute or two you get used to it.

I only wear mineral sunblocks (zinc oxide, titanium dioxide), and am always looking for something gentle enough for rosacea and mature skin. I am fair-skinned, so I did not find that there was a white cast on my skin. I apply it several minutes after moisturizing, and it goes on very smoothly, and feels wonderfully soothing on my skin.

extraits.titre: Works well for me, not sure it's for everyone though
extraits.texte: I have EXTREMELY pale cool toned skin and I will say this still left a white cast, given my skintone it's unnoticeable although for medium to dark skin I'm not sure if this non tinted one would work. The formula is creamy and very light. I also have sensory issues so I cannot stand greasy sunscreen, this one feels a bit greasy at first but once you rub it in I doesn't seem to feel like much! Which I super appreciate cause other sunscreens that sometimes don't feel bad when rubbing in end up feeling heavy and sticky :) I will also say I struggle with acne and it burns slightly when it's put over breakouts but it cools down after a few minutes, so it may not be great for very sensitive skin ❤ I find it works well enough for me and compared to others I've tried it's awesome... But I can definitely see how it wouldn't work for some people

i've gone through maybe 7 or 8 bottles of this and i will continue to repurchase this. it is a little more on the pricier side but a bottle lasts me 4-5 months so i wouldn't say its too bad. it used to leave a slight white finish but once i figured out how to use it properly, i no longer have any issues with this spf. i have combination skin - a little more on the oily side, and my mom has very oily skin. we are both acne prone and this doesnt break either of us out. this is literally my holy grail and i will neverrrr stop buying this!!

extraits.titre: Recommended by my Dermatologist for Melasma protection
extraits.texte: I love this sunscreen! I started using this years ago as my daily morning moisterizer and sun protectant. I am very pale and have dry skin, so this formula is lovely for me. I detect a faint white cast until it absorbs into my skin, so those with any type of pigment in their skin might not like this product. Those with oily skin - I'm not sure how this would react with your oils, either. My dermatologist recommended this to me once I developed mild Melasma in June 2020. I now use even more of this product to protect my skin!
